podcast.title: Band Composition and Origin
podcast.body: Fairground Attraction was a four-piece, folk pop band from Scotland, based in London. "The band is fair ground attraction. A four-piece, folk pop, Scottish band based in London."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 50 Biggest Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of All Time: Part 2 (40-31)

podcast.title: International Success (Excluding North America)
podcast.body: The band achieved significant success in Sweden, Australia, New Zealand, and South Africa, and was a "monster" hit in the UK with their 1988 album. "And they did well too, but only in Sweden, Australia, New Zealand, and South Africa."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 50 Biggest Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of All Time: Part 2 (40-31)

podcast.title: Mumford & Sons Comparison
podcast.body: Fairground Attraction is described as being "the Mumford and sons of their day," suggesting a similar folk-pop style and popularity. "They were, in a sense, the Mumford and sons of their day."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
srcs.episode: The 50 Biggest Alt-Rock One-Hit Wonders of All Time: Part 2 (40-31)

xref.title: Comparison to Fairground Attraction
xref.body: Fairground Attraction is described as "the Mumford and sons of their day," suggesting a similar folk-pop style and level of popularity in their era. "They were, in a sense, the Mumford and sons of their day."
